title: Sweet Dalia Porridge
description: Broken wheat simmered in milk with jaggery, cardamom, almonds and raisins, a comforting North Indian breakfast.
steps: Heat the ghee in a heavy pan and roast the dalia on low heat for 3 to 4 minutes until it smells nutty.
Pour in the milk and the water and bring to a boil, stirring.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the dalia is soft.
Add the jaggery powder, crushed cardamom, almonds and raisins and cook for 3 minutes more.
Serve hot, adding a splash of warm milk if you want it looser.
